screen.king.hint: Click or press 1–7 · Center: Realm of Carcosa · Y or ESC closes
msg.king.notking: You do not carry the King's Presence.
king.ability.0.desc: Golden shockwave: push, slow, weaken, moderate damage, ground mark
king.ability.1.desc: Golden chains hold several targets 2–3 s and pull them slightly
king.ability.2.desc: Teleport up to 20 blocks; aim at an enemy to appear behind them
king.ability.3.desc: 3 illusory copies; you turn nearly invisible and everyone is confused
king.ability.4.desc: Pick a player, 1.5 s charge, then a high-damage yellow beam
king.ability.5.desc: Ground markers; 2 s later meteors fall and leave corrupted zones
king.ability.6.desc: Ultimate: Carcosa's sky, golden fog, everyone marked, clones and waves
